summary: Financial modeling app with an Inputs dashboard. Removing PDF export, fixing Models Save action, and fixing duplicate Equity Ratio and Interest Rate fields in the Inputs dashboard.
known_issues: Equity Ratio and Interest Rate are duplicated in the Inputs dashboard

existing_features.title: Remove the PDF export option entirely from the Export tab. This includes removing the PDF download button/UI from ExportTab.tsx, removing or disabling any calls to usePdfExport, and removing the print styles from index.css that were used for PDF export.

Investigate and fix the failing 'Save' action for projects in SaveProjectModal.tsx and the related backend call. Ensure that saving a project correctly calls the backend saveProject method via the mutation in useQueries.ts, handles errors gracefully, and shows a success toast on completion.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix the duplicate Equity Ratio and Interest Rate fields in the Inputs dashboard. These fields are defined in FinancingSection.tsx and should appear exactly once. Audit InputsTab.tsx and FinancingSection.tsx to identify where the duplication occurs (e.g., fields rendered twice or EconomicParametersSection also rendering them) and remove the duplicate instances.
